name: Cordless Car Vacuum Cleaner
subtitle: 120W Rechargeable Handheld Cleaning Tool
description: This 3-in-1 cordless handheld vacuum cleaner is designed for quick cleaning of car interiors and small spaces. Its 120W motor delivers up to 6000Pa suction, while the rechargeable design, HEPA filtration and nozzle attachments help tackle dust, crumbs and dry debris.
story: Made for everyday clean-ups, this compact vacuum helps reach the places larger cleaners can struggle with, including narrow gaps, corners, seats and floor areas. The cordless rechargeable design allows cleaning away from a wall socket, with runtime rated up to around 18 minutes. Multiple nozzle attachments support different cleaning tasks, while the built-in HEPA filter is designed to handle fine particles. Its handheld format also makes storage and carrying straightforward between uses.

specs.recommended_use: Car interiors and small cleaning tasks

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
